requirements.evidence: Contract met exactly: enum CallMode with the three string cases (app/Enums/CallMode.php:7-14), NoWaitingTicketsException extends RuntimeException (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:7), invokable CallNextTicket with the required signature (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:22-26). Queue row locked and is_active read from the locked row (CallNextTicket.php:30-37); candidates restricted to waiting tickets of the queue with priority desc / issued_at / id ordering (:89-95); mode filters (:97-101); fairness reads last 3 called tickets by called_at desc, id desc and requires a waiting normal (:111-134); candidate re-locked and re-checked, skipped via $skippedIds (:63-72); fallback when fairness normals are drained (:45-52); only status/called_at/called_by_user_id assigned (:74-77) and the saved model returned. Docs updated in both required files. Only small caveat: fairness history filters on status = Called (:115), which would miss called tickets that later move to another status, if such statuses exist.

conventions.evidence: Domain write lives in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php (one class per use case, no service layer); authorization explicitly out of scope per task.md. Pest feature test added (tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php). docs/business-rules.md and docs/architecture.md updated to describe the implementation, CHANGELOG.md updated under [Unreleased] (CHANGELOG.md:9). PHPDoc on the private helpers and enum cases.

security.evidence: No HTTP/Livewire surface and authorization is out of scope (caller trusted per task). No mass assignment: fields set individually (CallNextTicket.php:74-76). Concurrency handled with lockForUpdate on queue and ticket rows inside DB::transaction (:27-33, :63-66). No raw SQL or output.

tests.evidence: 21 Pest tests cover ordering (priority, issued_at, id tie-break), returned state, other-queue isolation, empty queue, both restricted modes and their rejections, fairness trigger/no-normal/reset/<3 history/priority_only counting/ignored in priority_only, inactive and stale queue (CallNextTicketTest.php:45-310). Gaps: the 'skips tickets already called elsewhere' test (:300-309) calls $first before invoking the action, so the query already excludes it and the lock-and-recheck skip branch is never exercised; no test for normal_only calls counting in history or for the fairness-drained fallback path; write-once is only checked for issued_at.

simplicity.evidence: Single action with two small private helpers; one query builder handles all modes (CallNextTicket.php:87-104); reuses InactiveQueueException and TicketStatus; no extra abstractions. The while(true) loop is the minimum needed for skip-and-retry.

readability.evidence: Clear names (nextCandidate, fairnessApplies, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_PRIORITY_CALLS), short comments explaining the lock rationale (CallNextTicket.php:28-29, :61-62) and the fallback (:46-48). Test helpers memberQueue/waitingTicket/calledTicket keep tests short. Minor: comment says 'ticket::call()' lowercase (:61).

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: action, enum, exception, test, the two required docs and the changelog entry. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The 'skips tickets already called elsewhere' test calls the ticket before the action runs, so the candidate query never returns it and the lock-and-recheck skip branch (CallNextTicket.php:68-72) has no coverage.
No test covers normal_only calls counting in the fairness history or the fallback when fairness was triggered but no normal candidate remains (CallNextTicket.php:45-52).
Fairness history filters on status = Called rather than on called_at, so tickets called and later moved to another status (if the lifecycle has one) would drop out of the last-3 history.
Global helper functions (memberQueue, waitingTicket, calledTicket) in a Pest file can collide with same-named helpers in other test files; scoping or uniquely naming them is safer.
The doc states the queue lock also serializes issuance and deactivation, a claim about code not in this diff that the change cannot substantiate.

review.summary: The change adds CallMode, NoWaitingTicketsException and a CallNextTicket action that locks the queue, applies the deterministic ordering, mode filters and 3-call fairness rule, re-locks and re-checks the candidate, and marks it called, with docs and changelog updated. It meets the contract and conventions cleanly; the main gaps are in tests (the concurrent-skip branch and the fairness fallback are not really exercised), so I would approve with small follow-ups.
